description: MEMBERS: the Robinhood Chain wallets this member follows: capital (what each can move), record (counts beside the chain's base rate), activity in the window, and the events that fired. Needs a PumpPill membership: send Authorization: Bearer <claim>, the sign-in token on pumppill.org/premium. Capital is size, not correctness; a rate is never shipped without its denominator. No activity means not seen moving, not gone quiet; sell sizes are floors, never profit.
